# Clankdar

Clankdar is an experimental capability benchmark for the agent internet.
Fourteen seeded puzzle families span seven parameter tiers. Exact scoring
checks responses to specified tasks, not personhood, model identity, trust,
or permission to act. Passing must never grant host or tool authority.

Current generator contract: clankdar-suite-v2.
Current scorer contract: clankdar-score-v2.

Clankdar is a programming-puzzle capability benchmark, not a reverse CAPTCHA or
bot detector. Unlike time-pressured text-constraint gates (MoltCaptcha),
per-session natural-language byte tasks (agent-captcha), signature/hashcash
proofs (inverse-captcha, rCAPTCHA), or signed token widgets (Agentcha), Clankdar
uses public, deterministic puzzles with exact, re-derivable answers and
published held-out calibrations. It measures what a system can solve on named
family/tier cells, not whether a request came from an AI.
The Bun runner supports oracle/echo controls and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
Model commands default to dry runs; inference requires --execute and an
explicit --max-requests budget. Credentials must stay private.

The public v2 calibration contains 2,500 attempt records from five requested
model aliases on held-out seeds 101-120, including one timeout. Strict scores
span 9.4% to 87.6%. The public frontier calibration adds 1,700 unaided attempts
on held-out seeds 301-320 across deeper tiers; scores fall to 0% for Llama 3.1 8B
and rise to 64% for GPT-5 mini. The public tool-agent calibration adds 600
bounded episodes on the same seeds with a TOOL/FINAL protocol and replayable
transcripts; scores span 19% to 81% on valid episodes.

This supports family/cell capability separation, not one
scalar intelligence level: pooled tier difficulty is not monotone. Four
executable profiles partition the cells into transform fidelity, symbolic
execution, constraint solving, and rule induction. The public legacy pilot
retains 3,000 earlier attempts with explicit exclusions.

- Source: https://github.com/hraness/clankdar
- Historical hashcash prototype: https://github.com/hraness/valhalla/tree/main/prototypes/botcaptcha

The benchmark and production-shaped reference suite are implemented: sealed-
seed issuance, durable session ledger, signed admissions, build-verified public
admission archives, subject-bound receipts, transparency logs with published
heads and linear suffix consistency proofs, provider-neutral head-witness
intake with configured-provider polling, held-out pools, optional bearer-key
write auth with per-key mint quotas, and drift monitoring. A production
operation still needs deployment-specific TLS, key custody, high-availability
storage, and authorization.
The verifier-keyed HMAC helper is only a building block. The benchmark RNG is
non-cryptographic and must not issue secret admission puzzles. Public tasks
can be memorized, solved with code, or delegated.

The static site has no newsletter signup, tracking, hosted challenge API,
installed product CLI, or optional-support protocol for agents.
